subject: Game Theory
title: The Ultimatum Game
description: A micro-lesson that makes The Ultimatum Game usable.

hook.text: I offer you a split of $100. You can accept or reject. If you reject, we both get zero.

buildup.text: Rational theory says you should accept any positive offer. Even $1 is better than nothing.

discovery.text: In experiments, people routinely reject offers below $20-30. They punish unfairness at their own cost.

twist.text: The game reveals that humans value fairness, not just money. Evolution may have hardwired this instinct.

climax.text: Cross-cultural studies show fairness norms vary. Some cultures accept $10; others reject $40 as insulting.

punchline.text: Fairness beats cold logic every time.

quiz.question: What do experiments show about ultimatum game offers below 20%?
